affiliations.role_title: Writer in the magazine division and publicity department
affiliations.date_precision: A contemporary report says Dannenberg had worked in the CBS magazine division and network publicity department for five years and resigned on November 17, 1941, to join COI.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact uncommon name, direct COI transition, and presence in the OSS index support a high-confidence identity match. CBS is the last documented civilian employer before the intervening government assignment; it is not labeled the immediate OSS affiliation.

affiliations.date_precision: The contemporary source reports a November 17, 1941 start in COI's New York office on Edd Johnson's shortwave-intelligence staff. NARA documents that COI became OSS on June 13, 1942.
affiliations.research_notes: COI is preserved as a separate government assignment and organizational predecessor. The evidence supports continuity into OSS, but not a precise post-June 1942 title.
